# KiriTour Madagascar

> Local tour operator based in Morondava, Madagascar. Private 4x4 tours with local guides to the Avenue of the Baobabs, Kirindy Forest, Tsingy de Bemaraha and the Tsiribihina River, plus tailor-made trips to Andasibe, Antananarivo, the RN7, Nosy Be and Sainte-Marie.

## Key facts
- Based in: Morondava, Menabe region, western Madagascar
- What we do: private tours with our own drivers and local guides, from day trips to multi-day circuits, and tailor-made trips across Madagascar
- Speciality: the west — Avenue of the Baobabs, Kirindy Forest, Tsingy de Bemaraha (UNESCO), Tsiribihina River
- Also organised: Andasibe rainforest, Antananarivo, the RN7 road trip to the south, Nosy Be and Sainte-Marie
- Travellers guided: 500+
- Google rating: 4.4 / 5 (8 reviews) — https://maps.app.goo.gl/TCuJ6BVSJZhCpbk37
- Languages: English, French, Malagasy
- Prices: every tour page shows the price for 1 traveller and for a group. Group prices depend on group size and needs. Day trips from 145€. Tours without a fixed price are quoted on request.
- Booking: free quote on WhatsApp or by email, a deposit by bank transfer confirms the tour, balance on arrival
- Best season: April to November (Tsingy de Bemaraha is usually closed in the rainy months)
- Contact: WhatsApp +261 33 664 07 77 · infokiritourmadagascar@gmail.com · we usually reply within about 2 hours

## Destinations
- [Avenue of the Baobabs tours](https://kiritourmadagascar.com/tours/avenue-of-the-baobabs/): Visit the Avenue of the Baobabs with a local Morondava team: sunset at the giant baobabs, Baobab Amoureux, Betania fishing village and Kimony beach. Prices, best time and tips.
- [Kirindy Forest tours](https://kiritourmadagascar.com/tours/kirindy-forest/): Kirindy Forest tours from Morondava: the best place in Madagascar to see the fossa, sifakas, brown lemurs and mouse lemurs on a night walk. 1 or 2-day trips with a local guide.
- [Tsingy de Bemaraha tours](https://kiritourmadagascar.com/tours/tsingy-de-bemaraha/): Tsingy de Bemaraha tours from Morondava: Grand and Petit Tsingy, Manambolo gorge and the drive via the Avenue of the Baobabs. 3 and 4-day circuits with a local team.
- [Tsiribihina River trips](https://kiritourmadagascar.com/tours/tsiribihina-river/): Tsiribihina River descent by traditional pirogue, with camps on the sandbanks — alone or combined with Kirindy, the baobabs and Tsingy de Bemaraha in 3 to 8-day circuits.
- [Andasibe rainforest tours](https://kiritourmadagascar.com/tours/andasibe/): Andasibe rainforest tours from Antananarivo: hear the indri sing, night walks, Mantadia and the aye-aye at Palmarium. 3 to 5-day trips organised by KiriTour.
- [Antananarivo city tours](https://kiritourmadagascar.com/tours/antananarivo/): Discover Antananarivo with a local guide: the royal hill, markets, lakes and craft workshops, plus day trips to Ambohimanga. Tailor-made by KiriTour Madagascar.
- [RN7 road trip to the south](https://kiritourmadagascar.com/tours/rn7-south-madagascar/): Road trip on the RN7 through the highlands to the south: Antsirabe, Ambositra, Ranomafana rainforest, Anja reserve, Isalo National Park and the coast. Tailor-made by KiriTour.
- [Nosy Be trips](https://kiritourmadagascar.com/tours/nosy-be/): Nosy Be with a local team: island hopping to Nosy Komba and Nosy Tanikely, Lokobe reserve, beaches and sunsets. Tailor-made extensions by KiriTour Madagascar.
- [Sainte-Marie island trips](https://kiritourmadagascar.com/tours/sainte-marie/): Sainte-Marie island (Nosy Boraha) on the east coast: humpback whales from July to September, quiet beaches and Île aux Nattes. Tailor-made by KiriTour Madagascar.

## Travel guides
- [How to Get to Andasibe from Antananarivo (Indri Lemurs Guide)](https://kiritourmadagascar.com/blog/how-to-get-to-andasibe/): Andasibe is the easiest rainforest to reach from Antananarivo and the best place to hear the indri lemur. Here's how to get there by private car or public transport, how long it takes and how many nights to stay.
- [How to Get to Nosy Be: Flights, Road and Ferry from Ankify](https://kiritourmadagascar.com/blog/how-to-get-to-nosy-be/): Nosy Be is Madagascar's best-known island. You can fly there directly from abroad, take a domestic flight from Antananarivo, or travel overland to Ankify and cross by boat. Here's how each option works.
- [How to Travel the RN7: Car with Driver, Taxi-Brousse or Flights](https://kiritourmadagascar.com/blog/how-to-travel-the-rn7-madagascar/): The RN7 runs almost 1,000 km from Antananarivo to Tuléar. Should you hire a car with a driver, take the taxi-brousse, or fly part of the way? Here's how to get around the RN7 and get back to Antananarivo.
- [How to Get to Morondava from Antananarivo: Flight, Road or River](https://kiritourmadagascar.com/blog/how-to-get-to-morondava/): Morondava is the gateway to the Avenue of the Baobabs, Kirindy and the Tsingy. Here are the three ways to get there from Antananarivo — by plane, by road or down the Tsiribihina River — with real travel times and tips from our local team.
- [Madagascar Itinerary: How to Spend 2 Weeks (Baobabs, Tsingy, Lemurs & Beach)](https://kiritourmadagascar.com/blog/madagascar-2-week-itinerary/): Two weeks is the sweet spot for Madagascar. Here's a realistic day-by-day plan combining the Avenue of the Baobabs, Tsingy de Bemaraha, Andasibe's lemurs and a few days on an island.
- [Best Time to Visit Madagascar: Month-by-Month Guide by Region](https://kiritourmadagascar.com/blog/best-time-to-visit-madagascar/): Madagascar's weather changes a lot from region to region. Here's when to go for the baobabs and Tsingy, the rainforest lemurs, the RN7 and the islands — and which months to avoid.
- [Where to See Lemurs in Madagascar: The 7 Best Places](https://kiritourmadagascar.com/blog/where-to-see-lemurs-in-madagascar/): From the singing indri of Andasibe to the dancing sifakas of the west, here are the best places in Madagascar to see lemurs in the wild — and how to combine them in one trip.
- [How Much Does a Madagascar Tour Cost? Real Prices for 2026](https://kiritourmadagascar.com/blog/madagascar-tour-cost/): What should you budget for a private tour in Madagascar? We break down real prices for day trips, Tsingy circuits and river descents, and explain what makes a tour cheaper or more expensive.
- [RN7 Road Trip Madagascar: Antananarivo to Tuléar Guide](https://kiritourmadagascar.com/blog/rn7-road-trip-madagascar/): The RN7 is Madagascar's classic road trip — from the highlands of Antsirabe to the rainforest of Ranomafana, the canyons of Isalo and the beaches near Tuléar. Here's how to plan it.
- [Nosy Be or Sainte-Marie? Which Madagascar Island to Choose](https://kiritourmadagascar.com/blog/nosy-be-or-sainte-marie/): Ending your Madagascar trip on an island? Here's how Nosy Be and Sainte-Marie compare — beaches, whales, atmosphere, best season — so you can choose the right one.
- [Antananarivo in One Day: What to See in Madagascar's Capital](https://kiritourmadagascar.com/blog/antananarivo-city-tour/): Have a day in Antananarivo before or after your tour? Here's how to spend it: the Queen's Palace, the old town, markets, Lake Anosy and the royal hill of Ambohimanga.
- [Best Time to Visit the Avenue of the Baobabs (2026 Guide)](https://kiritourmadagascar.com/blog/best-time-visit-avenue-baobabs-madagascar/): Planning to see Madagascar's most iconic sunset? Here's exactly when to visit the Avenue of the Baobabs for the best light, weather and fewest crowds.
- [Tsingy de Bemaraha: Complete Travel Guide 2026](https://kiritourmadagascar.com/blog/tsingy-de-bemaraha-travel-guide/): Everything you need to know to visit Tsingy de Bemaraha — Madagascar's UNESCO stone forest: how to get there, what to expect, difficulty and the best tours.
- [How to See the Fossa & Lemurs in Kirindy Forest](https://kiritourmadagascar.com/blog/kirindy-forest-fossa-lemurs-guide/): Kirindy Forest is the best place in Madagascar to spot the elusive fossa, plus lemurs and nocturnal wildlife. Here's how to maximise your sightings.
- [Tsiribihina River Descent: Complete Guide 2026](https://kiritourmadagascar.com/blog/tsiribihina-river-descent-complete-guide/): A 2-3 day pirogue descent down the Tsiribihina is one of Madagascar's great adventures. Here's what to expect, when to go and how to prepare.
- [Madagascar Itinerary: How to Plan Your Trip from Morondava](https://kiritourmadagascar.com/blog/madagascar-itinerary-from-morondava/): Morondava is the gateway to western Madagascar's icons. Here's how to plan a 3, 5 or 7+ day itinerary covering baobabs, Tsingy, Kirindy and the river.
- [What to Pack for a Madagascar Safari & Tour](https://kiritourmadagascar.com/blog/what-to-pack-madagascar-safari/): Heading to Madagascar's baobabs, Tsingy and forests? This practical packing list covers clothing, gear and essentials for a comfortable western Madagascar trip.
